howtoText:
1. Enter the address of your OpenDTU – the same one you open in your browser (e.g. 192.168.1.50).
2. Enter the password of the OpenDTU web interface. It is needed to limit the power and, if read-only access is switched off in OpenDTU, also to read the values.
3. Save. After a few seconds the values appear under Objects → opendtu.0.
passwordHelp: Same password as for the OpenDTU web interface (user admin)
useInvOfflineStatesToZero: Set values to 0 when an inverter is not reachable (e.g. at night)
useInvOfflineStatesToZeroHelp: Recommended. Otherwise the last values of the evening remain visible all night. Yield values are kept.
protectNames: Keep my own names of the objects
protectNamesHelp: Switch on if you renamed objects in ioBroker. The adapter then no longer overwrites the names.
